In detail

Monte Sacro Alto, overlapping in local usage with the Talenti area, is a well-established, mostly middle-class residential district near Villa Ada and Via Nomentana. Searches in both Italian and English press turned up no specific reports of crime, drug dealing, or public-order problems tied to this zone.
